originalFindingDispositions15.identity: N06-N02: Keep Start diagnostics out of lifecycle continuity
originalFindingDispositions15.body: N06-N02 — completePacket freezes rootEventsAfter before calling recordFn('native-action', serializable, ...), but this new history filter accepts every event with the root tuple, including that subsequently recorded native-action. evaluateCorrelatedStateAndTime likewise includes native-action in rootEvents. Consequently the first running sample after an ordinary Start contains at least Start's own extra event, while witness.js:43 uses the pre-emission rootEventsAfter as its baseline and witness-domain.js:92-94 rejects the length difference. The normal startWitnessTimer path therefore rejects correct running behavior before returning. Use consistent lifecycle-event filtering on both packet and correlated-read histories, keeping action diagnostics separate from pause/resume continuity.

originalFindingDispositions15.identity: Declare firstExpiredSample before the witness polling callback
originalFindingDispositions15.body: Correction07 removes correction06's local declaration of firstExpiredSample, but the complete function and module contain no replacement declaration. Once a valid expired sample reaches this branch, assigning firstExpiredSample throws ReferenceError in this ES module; subsequent reads also reference an unbound identifier. Even with a valid supplied startRecord and corrected history routing, waitForWitnessExpiry cannot produce the required expiry/crossover result. originalFindingDispositions15.identity: N06-N02: Validate capture-to-post history before adopting Start
originalFindingDispositions15.body: N06-N02 — the Start record adopts only post-handler histories, silently replaces missing histories with empty arrays, and never compares rootEventsBefore/docEventsBefore against rootEventsAfter/docEventsAfter. validatePacketPrerequisites does not establish history health or this continuity either. Thus a visibility/root-history discontinuity occurring across Start can become the accepted baseline instead of rejecting the Start bracket, and missing packet histories can become a supposedly initialized empty baseline. The native history filter also returns event-object references rather than independently frozen capture/post content. Require valid independently copied capture/post histories and their complete continuity before constructing startRecord; retain legitimate observed empty histories without substituting them for missing provenance.

originalFindingDispositions15.identity: N06-N03: Bind history health to actual recorder bookkeeping
originalFindingDispositions15.body: N06-N03 — eventSeq is incremented privately, but no consumer receives or checks the expected store identity, count, or full sequence against that bookkeeping. The recorder still writes directly to the replaceable public window.__nsLifecycleEvents, and observed health is only Array.isArray. Replacing a nonempty store with [] or clearing it therefore leaves recorderReady true and hasLifecycleEvents true; correlated validation accepts the arrays and buildCorrelatedSample computes zero completed hidden time. Missing/non-array storage additionally makes this record function silently stop without marking the recorder unhealthy. Introduce actual retained-store health/sequence validation so replacement or truncation rejects while an untouched initialized empty store remains valid.

originalFindingDispositions15.identity: Retain lifecycle mutations drained at native action boundaries
originalFindingDispositions15.body: N06-N02/N06-N03 — capture and bubble call advanceTriggerFn(tCap/tBub) before extracting histories. Draining pending class mutations invokes __nsProcessClassMutations, which assigns deliveryMax using a later performance.now(), so a mutation already drained at the boundary can have tMax greater than that boundary. This new tMax <= maxTime filter then omits it from rootEventsBefore/rootEventsAfter, although pause-pair collection uses tMin and can include the same event, and a subsequent correlated read includes it. A genuine pre-Start child hidden/resume history can therefore disappear from Start's baseline and produce a false continuity failure or inconsistent clock provenance. Freeze all actually observed boundary history while retaining its uncertainty interval instead of dropping drained events because delivery completed later.

Record every actual snapshot occurrence in its observed order, retain independent document/recorder failures, and propagate the earliest normalized returned occurrence rather than the domain wrapper.

originalFindingDispositions15.body: E06-01 remains open. ingestPreexistingErrors marks every caller-owned secondaryFailures array, including an empty array, in callerOwnedSecondaryArrays. originalFindingDispositions15.identity: E06-01 Deduplicate caller ledger records by identity, not order
originalFindingDispositions15.body: E06-01 remains open. In the caller-owned errorLedger branch, any existing item with the same order suppresses the new serialized occurrence, even when it is a different record. For example, with a preserved caller errorLedger containing an unrelated record at order 2, recording a primary and then a frame/close failure gives the latter order 2 and prevents its serialized record from being exposed. Caller orders and this ledger's orders are independent namespaces; preserve existing objects and track this ledger's appended serialized objects by identity instead of deduplicating by order.
